GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Roofing & waterproofing

We investigate where water enters and how it travels through the building before defining the repair. Our scope can include commercial roof repairs, box gutters, flashings, penetrations and waterproofing details. For coastal properties, we check the existing material, exposed fixings and signs of salt-related deterioration.

What we can look after

  • Roof sheets, flashings, penetrations and localised leak repairs.
  • Box gutters, outlets and roof drainage defects.
  • Balcony, terrace and building waterproofing repairs within the agreed scope.

Planning the work

  1. We trace the reported leak and document accessible roof and drainage conditions.
  2. We confirm repair details, compatible materials and roof access arrangements.
  3. We check the completed work and record the treated areas and follow-up observations.

Questions about this service

Does a leaking commercial roof always need replacing?+

We assess the roof condition, the leak source and the extent of deterioration first. We then set out whether a local repair, a wider repair scope or replacement addresses the problem, with the relevant access and material requirements.
